# RP2350A export fixture

`drawing.ecaddraw` is the converted Raspberry Pi `RPI-RP2350A-MINIMAL_R4-S1` minimal reference schematic (see `LICENSE.txt` for Raspberry Pi's MIT license).

Keep this fixture unchanged: export tests rely on its embedded symbol geometry, rotated components, wires, and text to verify SVG, PNG, and PDF coverage and sheet bounds deterministically.
